title: Validating exit settings at load

options.name: Keep current behaviour: accept any value; NaN falls back for some keys and silently disables the trailing stop for others
options.risk: A typo can disable the trailing stop, sell at once, or tear down protection on a held position (AUD-EXIT-016).

options.name: Range-check every exit setting at load and refuse to start on a bad value
options.behavior_impact: A bad value stops the bot at boot with a clear message.
options.risk: A config that runs today may refuse to start.

default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). Capital-relevant, but the linked findings are S2 or lower, so the default is safe to rest on until then.
behavior_impact: Decides what the bot does with an out-of-range exit setting.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
